ECON 202  INTERMEDIATE MACROECONOMICS          Fall 2026
Prof. L. Hartmann        Tue/Thu 11:00-12:15     Rm 204 Baker Hall
Email: hartmann@univ.edu     Office hrs Wed 2-4pm

Course Objectives
Students will analyze growth models, business cycles, monetary and fiscal policy,
and open-economy macroeconomics using formal models and data.

Assessment
Problem Sets (5)			25%
Data Project				15%
Midterm					25%
Final Exam				35%
